title: Maqluba with Quinoa and Eastern Spices
description: A traditional Middle Eastern dish with a twist, featuring quinoa and a zesty fermented sauce.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the Middle Eastern spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the quinoa and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add 2 cups of water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the quinoa is tender.
Stir in the zesty fermented sauce and season with salt to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
